cohort: 3,352,615 puerperae from the 2019 US National Vital Statistics System
finding: Smoking during pregnancy and gestational diabetes mellitus were individually associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery, and a synergistic effect between the two exposures was observed, particularly in women of non-advanced age, white women, those overweight before pregnancy, and primiparae.
mod_finding: Smoking during pregnancy and gestational diabetes mellitus were associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery, with a synergistic effect between the two factors.
